instruction: Carry out the following with the already opened Bonsai/Blender IFC authoring environment and its CLI/API tools: update /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and save /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc. For this task, Bonsai is installed as a Blender extension, so start `/opt/blender/blender` and use the Bonsai tools from that environment. Do not create, rewrite, copy, patch, or post-process the IFC outside that software environment. The model is a two-storey office envelope inherited from an older IFC2x3 exchange. The geometry is still useful, but the owner now requires an IFC4 deliverable with a simpler envelope specification. Preserve the two-storey massing, rooms, walls, slabs, and roof, migrate the file to the current IFC4 handover, consolidate the exterior walls under the primary wall type, keep both slabs under the shared slab type, and group the migrated envelope as one review set. Mark the migrated objects with revision code BONSAI-CLI-18 and retain a clear note that the source schema was IFC2X3.
